# Manipulation of high-dimensional arrays in R with the magic package

![](reference/figures/magic.png)

# Overview

The magic package implements functionality for manipulating
high-dimensional arrays using efficient vectorised methods. The original
application was high-dimensional magic hypercubes. This README shows
some of the more useful functions in the package.

# Installation

You can install the released version of `magic` from
[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org) with:

``` r
# install.packages("magic")  # uncomment this to install the package
library("magic")
```

# Package highlights

- Function
  [`adiag()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/adiag.md)
  binds arbitrarily-dimensioned arrays corner-to-corner
- Function
  [`apad()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/apad.md) pads
  arbitrarily-dimensioned arrays
- Function
  [`apldrop()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/apl.md) is
  a replacement for APL’s drop
- Function
  [`aplus()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/aplus.md)
  superimposes two arrays of different dimensions and returns the sum of
  overlapping elements
- Function
  [`arev()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/arev.md) is a
  multidimensional generalization of
  [`rev()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/rev.html)
- Function
  [`arot()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/arot.md) is a
  generalization of matlab’s `rotdim`
- Function
  [`fnsd()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/fnsd.md)
  returns the first nonsingleton dimension of an arbitrary dimensioned
  array
- Function
  [`ashift()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/shift.md)
  shifts the origin of arbitrary dimensioned arrays

Much of the package functionality is vectorised in array dimension.

# Further information

For more detail, see the package vignette

`vignette("magic")`

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Frankenstein`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/Frankenstein.md)
  : A perfect magic cube due to Frankenstein
- [`Ollerenshaw`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/Ollerenshaw.md)
  : A most perfect square due to Ollerenshaw
- [`adiag()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/adiag.md)
  [`adiag2()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/adiag.md) :
  Binds arrays corner-to-corner
- [`allsubhypercubes()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/allsubhypercubes.md)
  : Subhypercubes of magic hypercubes
- [`allsums()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/allsums.md)
  : Row, column, and two diagonal sums of arrays
- [`apad()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/apad.md) :
  Pad arrays
- [`apldrop()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/apl.md)
  [`` `apldrop<-`() ``](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/apl.md)
  [`apltake()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/apl.md)
  [`` `apltake<-`() ``](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/apl.md)
  : Replacements for APL functions take and drop
- [`aplus()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/aplus.md) :
  Generalized array addition
- [`arev()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/arev.md) :
  Reverses some dimensions; a generalization of rev
- [`arot()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/arot.md) :
  Rotates an array about two specified dimensions
- [`arow()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/arow.md) :
  Generalized row and col
- [`as.standard()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/as.standard.md)
  [`is.standard()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/as.standard.md)
  : Standard form for magic squares
- [`cilleruelo()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/cilleruelo.md)
  : A class of multiplicative magic squares due to Cilleruelo and Luca
- [`circulant()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/circulant.md)
  [`is.circulant()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/circulant.md)
  : Circulant matrices of any order
- [`cube2`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/cube2.md) : A
  pantriagonal magic cube
- [`diag.off()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/diag.off.md)
  : Extracts broken diagonals
- [`do.index()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/do.index.md)
  : Apply a function to array element indices
- [`eq()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/eq.md)
  [`ne()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/eq.md)
  [`gt()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/eq.md)
  [`lt()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/eq.md)
  [`ge()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/eq.md)
  [`le()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/eq.md)
  [`` `%eq%` ``](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/eq.md)
  [`` `%ne%` ``](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/eq.md)
  [`` `%gt%` ``](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/eq.md)
  [`` `%lt%` ``](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/eq.md)
  [`` `%ge%` ``](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/eq.md)
  [`` `%le%` ``](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/eq.md) :
  Comparison of two magic squares
- [`fnsd()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/fnsd.md) :
  First non-singleton dimension
- [`force.integer()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/force.integer.md)
  : Integerize array elements
- [`sylvester()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/hadamard.md)
  [`is.hadamard()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/hadamard.md)
  : Hadamard matrices
- [`hendricks`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/hendricks.md)
  : A perfect magic cube due to Hendricks
- [`hudson()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/hudson.md)
  : Pandiagonal magic squares due to Hudson
- [`is.magic()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.panmagic()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.pandiagonal()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.semimagic()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.semimagic.default()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.associative()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.normal()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.sparse()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.mostperfect()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.2x2.correct()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.bree.correct()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.latin()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.antimagic()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.totally.antimagic()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.heterosquare()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.totally.heterosquare()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.sam()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  [`is.stam()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magic.md)
  : Various tests for the magicness of a square
- [`is.semimagichypercube()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magichypercube.md)
  [`is.diagonally.correct()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magichypercube.md)
  [`is.magichypercube()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/is.magichypercube.md)

  [`is.incidence()`](https://robinhankin.github.io/magic/reference/latin.md)

  : Conway's lozenge algorithm for magic squares
